title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Characterize Cases of Illegally Copying Mobile Phone Numbers

articles.content_en: 1. The act of illegally copying and stealing mobile phone numbers shall be subject to severe punishment as the crime of theft. The amount of theft shall be calculated based on the mobile phone activation fee prescribed by the local postal and telecommunications department. If the amount from the sale of stolen goods (the amount after deducting the cost of the empty handset) exceeds the mobile phone activation fee prescribed by the local postal and telecommunications department, the amount of theft shall be calculated based on the amount from the sale of stolen goods.
2. Anyone who knowingly resells illegally copied mobile phones shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of selling stolen goods.

3. Anyone who knowingly uses an illegally copied mobile phone and causes losses to others shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of theft. The amount of theft shall be calculated based on the actual losses of the legitimate mobile phone user. If the actual losses cannot be directly confirmed, they shall be calculated by deducting the average monthly phone bill of the six months before the copying from the monthly bill after the legitimate user's mobile phone was copied. If the legitimate user has used the mobile phone for less than six months, the calculation shall be based on the average monthly phone bill of the actual usage period.
September 13, 1995
